AcupointDesc_0.en:
Torso acupoint seal will <color=#brightred>reduce Inhale recovery rate by at least 20%, up to 60%...</color>
<color=#yellow>Sealing multiple acupoints on the same area does not stack, and their effect weakens as time passes.</color>

When 3 acupoints on the torso are sealed, <color=#brightred>Martial Arts that require the torso can no longer be cast...</color>
AcupointDesc_0.cn:
胸背封穴会使人物<color=#brightred>提气的恢复速度降低至少20%、至多60%…</color>
<color=#yellow>同部位的多个封穴，效果不会叠加，且会随着持续时间减少而减弱</color>

胸背被封闭3个穴道时，<color=#brightred>需要胸背施展的功法将无法施展…</color>

AcupointDesc_1.en:
Midsection acupoint seal will <color=#brightred>reduce Stance recovery rate by at least 20%, up to 60%...</color>
<color=#yellow>Sealing multiple acupoints on the same area do not stack, and their effect weakens as time passes.</color>

When 3 acupoints on the midsection are sealed, <color=#brightred>Martial Arts that require the midsection can no longer be cast...</color>

腰腹封穴会使人物<color=#brightred>架势的恢复速度降低至少20%、至多60%…</color>
<color=#yellow>同部位的多个封穴，效果不会叠加，且会随着持续时间减少而减弱</color>

腰腹被封闭3个穴道时，<color=#brightred>需要腰腹施展的功法将无法施展…</color>

AcupointDesc_2.en:
Having a sealed Head-and-Neck acupoint <color=#brightred>reduces attack range by 0.4-0.8</color>.
<color=#yellow>Multiple sealed acupoints on the same body part do not stack but reduce and weaken over time.</color>

<color=#brightred>Martial Arts relying on your Head-and-Neck cannot be used</color> when 3 Head-and-Neck acupoints or more are sealed.
AcupointDesc_2.cn:
头颈封穴会<color=#brightred>减少人物至少0.4、至多0.8的攻击范围…</color>
<color=#yellow>同部位的多个封穴，效果不会叠加，且会随着持续时间减少而减弱</color>
